summary: Get permitted operations for a database
description:
Returns the permitted operations on specific database.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the database and its corresponding space.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the database for which operations should be returned.

200.description: Returned if the requested operations are returned.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if the calling user does not have permission to view the
requested database or the database was not found.
